cases.prompt: Review this CLI change. Contract: in `--json` mode stdout carries exactly one JSON document; progress goes to stderr; exit 0 on success. Old observation (v3.1): `acme list --json` printed `[{"id":1},{"id":2}]` to stdout and exited 0. New observation (v3.2): `acme list --json` prints `Fetching page 1/1...` on its own line to stdout, then the same JSON array, and exits 0. Supplied consumer parser, deploy/inventory.py: `items = json.loads(subprocess.check_output(["acme", "list", "--json"]))`.

cases.prompt: Review this CLI change. Contract (docs/cli.md): stdout carries only the requested output, diagnostics go to stderr, exit 0 success, 1 runtime failure, 2 usage error. Old invocation (v1.8): `acme sync --target prod` prints a summary line to stdout and exits 0; `acme sync` without --target exits 2. New (v1.9): adds an optional `--dry-run` flag, default false; the diff only branches on `opts.dryRun` before the write call. Observed on v1.9: `acme sync --target prod` prints the same summary and exits 0; `acme sync` still exits 2; `acme sync --target prod --dry-run` prints "would sync 12 items" and exits 0. Avoid manufacturing a finding when the specialist threshold is not met.
